description: The plugin's static hooks are mcp_tool calls to the bundled hooks server and all fail open: no onFailure, no command hook, no shell script, and no PermissionRequest or PreToolUse (the fail-closed decision hook is registered per launch only). This also bounds what Cursor can import from the Claude plugin (taxonomy-7.1). Nothing that crosses the privacy boundary is templated (no transcript or agent transcript path, tool response, permission suggestions or last assistant message). SubagentStop stays unregistered: a subagent's stop is not the end of the objective's work (fixtures/subagent-stop-background.json).
